In 2025 I gave a talk for the Talks for Ukraine series on structural causal models and valid conditionalisation strategies in PyMC. The slides can be found [here](https://nathanielf.github.io/talks/ukraine_sem/talk4ukraine.html#/title-slide).

The recording of the talk is available on YouTube.
